works: written from libratbag (8235b5bb), the Linux kernel's hid-roccat drivers (7be4bc52) and OpenRGB (bbc77470), and checked against simulated devices only (tests/sim-roccat-peripherals.mjs)

Kone Pure / Pure Optical / XTD / EMP: active profile (05, set 05 03 <n>), the DPI stage in use and each enabled DPI stage (settings block 06 after 04 <profile> 80); polling rate writable on the EMP, a reading on the Pure and XTD
Kone XP, Burst Pro, Burst Core: lighting brightness 0-255 (profile block 06); the Kone XP's active profile and firmware as readings
Kova, Vulcan family: firmware (and the Vulcan's layout) in the device info, read only
every block write is the whole block as just read with one setting changed and its Sum16 recomputed, always sent, then read back in full; anything else that moved sends the block read before back
reads go on while Swarm II runs; every write is refused while it runs
doesNotWork: firmware updates (never: reports 1B and 1C, and the Ryos reset 11, are on DeviceHub's never list)
battery: no source reads one on any ROCCAT mouse (Kone Pro Air and Burst Pro Air are write-only in OpenRGB)
Kone Pro (2c88): OpenRGB reads its block with report id 0 and overwrites bytes 3-5, so no read-back is documented
Kone Pro Air (2c8e, 2c92), Burst Pro Air (2ca6), Kone Aimo (2e27, 2e2c), Horde Aimo (303e): lights are write-only
DPI and polling rate on the Kone XP and Burst (units and codes not documented); lights other than brightness; buttons and macros
Vulcan lighting (effect mode, per-key colours: write-only); Turtle Beach Vulcan II (10f5:501b, 5023, 5001): a library entry has one vendor id
unconfirmed: the Kone Pure / XTD / EMP collection on Windows (interface 0, chosen by feature length) and whether the Burst's block 06 is the active profile's
